So lately I've watched a lot of animes, and yet none of them satisfied me or entertained me, to the point it should've left me with some impact or PAD. I've gotten a lot of recommendations and tried watching all of them but nothing could just make me enjoy anime. It's been like this for so long, where I just find anime so boring not like it used to. Anime used to be something i love watching as soon i got back from school, but it just doesn't feel the same anymore. for almost the past 2 years, theres only 5 animes i've actually enjoyed, with leaving me with some PAD, emotional impact, and something that changed my view on anime and other important things. Here are those animes:
https://anilist.co/anime/100675/Saekano-the-Movie-Finale/
https://anilist.co/anime/4181/Clannad-After-Story/
https://anilist.co/anime/21827/Violet-Evergarden/
https://anilist.co/anime/7674/Bakuman/
https://anilist.co/anime/9253/SteinsGate/



Basically the thing i loved while watching these animes that made me enjoy it and consider it as PEAK or a really good Hidden Gem, is that, they all have unique and originality that most animes dont have. I really like it when i just dive into an anime without knowing anything about it, as discovering something yourself without any information is just a good feeling which could lead you to find another anime that you'll love. But doing this doesn't make it good anymore as theres countless new animes every season, with most of them ending up as some edgy story which i have 0 interests of.


So if anyone has any recommendations, that might help me love and enjoy anime again, by giving me atleast some emotional impact, PAD, or any type of impact in my life and love for anime or something that will be craved into my memories my whole life, please recommend me some anime. Please don't spoil anything too much about the anime, as i want to dive into it without knowing anything about it, which will make my experience better.

Pretty much any Studio Ghibli film, specifically __Howl's moving castle__ or _Whisper of the Heart._
__Jujustu Kaisen__ is up there for when I think "__peak__," along with others such as __One Piece__, __Cyberpunk: edgerunners__, _Dragonball_, _Naruto_, __Code geass__, _Attack on Titan_, _Gintama_, __Hunter x Hunter__, _Demon Slayer_, _Chainsaw man_, __Fire force__, _Soul Eater_, __Frieren: Beyond Journey’s End__, __Bleach__, _Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood_, __One-Punch Man__, __No Game, No Life__.

Some more niche ones when I think of the word would be __Lupin the third__, __Steins; gate__, __The Eminence in Shadow__, _Kaguya-sama: Love is War_, __Dr. Stone__, __Cells at Work!__, __Cowboy Bebop__, __Vinland Saga__, __The Day I Became a God__,__ Pokemon__, __Re-zero__, __Mob Psycho 100__, __Akame ga Kill!__, _Beyond the Boundary_, _Erased_, _Konosuba_, _Noragami_, __The Legend of the Legendary Heroes__, _Bungo Stray Dogs_, __Bottom-Tier Character Tomozaki__, _Death Parade_, __SPY x FAMILY__, __JUNI TAISEN：ZODIAC WAR__, __Odd Taxi__, _Food Wars_, __Hellsing__ (abridged is better imo), __Magi__, __That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime__,  __The Heroic Legend of Arslan__

The Fate series is also up there for it's level of animation. _Ghost Stories_ is funny in English and a completely different show in Japaneese.

Peak sports anime __Hajime no Ippo__, __Slam Dunk__, and __Blue lock__.

I'd say ___Vagabond, Berserk, The Lord Of the Mysteries, and Omniscient Reader's viewpoint___ are my most anticipated and yearned for adaptations, and I can't wait to see ___Solo leveling___ animated as well on January 6th

text:
Thank god, I though some people were blind, claiming this was a 10/10 anime... 

But some points to criticize that got me mad since last season:
- Mappa claiming it to be "the last season" TWICE when it was not, basically deceiving the viewer (yeah, this is just a personal annoyance)
- The drop in art quality is significant (if you think it's not, I recommend you watching S1, S2 or S3 and compare them);
- The fact they used a LOT more cgi, specially on the titans, is just sad.
- The direction is questionable, even if they are following the manga.

Now, was is fun? I mean, it wasn't that bad, but it clearly wasn't the best when we have stuff out there being released some seasons ago that were clearly better handled.

I just don't think that aot is being handled in the best way, and it's probably suffering a bit by the end to something that could have been one of the best anime stories ever (also debatable by many).

 Not saying that you are not free to enjoy your favorite show, who am I to say what's "good" or "bad", that's totally up to the viewer, if you think this is peak anime, well, congrats? ahah I'm 100% that a lot of people won't consider Your Lie in April peak anime, and I'm totally okay with it! Just enjoy what you like :3

The Martial Peak novel has officially ended.

The novel's author announced that the story would end within a month, which they had written as a note at the end of chapter 5993. It has officially happened as of chapter 6009.

Ending: ~!It's one of those happily ever after endings, with the MC continuing his journey and appreciating his gains so far, after the greatest enemy was defeated!~

I discovered this after checking up on the rumors that the manhua was ending, only able to confirm the end of the novel. I'm not a reader of this novel, so this is big news to me still. With strong enough google-fu, you can confirm for yourself, especially with the chapter numbers supplied. 

I trust that the manhua adaptation is separate and isn't ending. It seemingly could wrap up nicely after the ~!Star Boundary arc, which is the land where Yang Kai currently is in, and is where the Emperors came from. I think Yang Kai has reset a few times already, starting from the bottom in cultivation before climbing to the "peak", before discovering the there are levels beyond his current world.!~

text: Martial peak is about cultivation, martial arts and a whole lot more. I would love to say this here that Momo(the author) is a sensational writer. The  Light Novel of this book has won numerous awards for being the best martial arts manga in China and there are various reasons why. I started reading this book as a manga but I finished at a fast rate and felt empty so I decided to look for the Light Novel and I have been engrossed with reading it, a light novel of over 5800+ chapters. So what made me continue, the MC is one of the reasons the way in which he acts and I'm the book his dedication to cultivating. I have read various martial arts Mangas but there is something unique about martial peak. He has a greedy mindset in making full use of his opportunities. So when he sees an opportunity he grasps it tightly and there is also ploy armour but he gets vicious when it is time for pay back. He is a really dependent guy and he trusts his capabilities. He alone can be able turn situations from bad to good. The book has upper realms so when you think you are done know that there is always another realm with a whole new interesting arc waiting for you. I will encourage you to try it, it may just be right for you.

pageTitle: Does Martial Peak get better? · AniList

text:
My impression: it's a tropey commoner-to-nobility (weakling-to-badass/boss) type story. Very slow start and very slow progress. Repetitive pattern of MC going to power-up, with others reacting to his progress and left guessing his mysterious methods...

At about 500 chapters in, all of the previous chapters seem to cash in on the progress, culminating in a big event.

Yang Kai's mama pretty much sums up the theme: Yang Kai repays respect with extreme generosity but repays disrespect with ruthless cruelty.

The sentiment is driven by the difference between true camaraderie (friends willing to sacrifice themselves to help) and alliances (selfish business relationships built from mutual benefit).

My [eyes watered at chapter 568](https://i.imgur.com/PuOcfwr.jpeg). I think this is the first time it's happened. The other drama wasn't written/translated well enough to touch/move me.

I think I kind of got trapped with the bandwagon effect, with that one ninja girl at the beginning "stalking" the MC. Since she was so excited, I was too. Kind of like how Maple (from BOFURI, AKA Shield Loli) was regularly followed and hyped up by the other characters. She's way too meek and protected by others for her to progress in her relationship with Yang Kai--she just seems to want to help him, making readers frustrated at how she doesn't understand her feelings and at how she seems to be more focused on duty. It's even more of a trap for anyone rooting for the two to hook up...

I was close to dropping. I also have it scoring slightly below average. I like the world and culture, but I undoubtedly believe [Tales of Demons and Gods](https://anilist.co/manga/86707/Yao-Shen-Ji/) and [Tower of God](https://anilist.co/manga/85143/Sinui-Tap/) do it a lot better. 

My verdict: Martial Peak is an epic time-killer full of filler.
